name: Neem (Azadirachta indica)
region: Tropical & Subtropical (South Asia, India, Arid regions)
waterFrequency: Once every 3-5 days when young, drought-resistant when mature
description: Fast-growing evergreen tree prized for shade, medicinal foliage, and natural organic pest control.
plantingAdvice: Plant in a broad open area with direct sunlight. Dig a hole twice the width of the root ball. Mix 5kg organic compost with native soil.
aftercareChecklist: Water deeply twice a week for first 3 months
Mulch around trunk base leaving 5cm distance
Prune lower side shoots during year 2 to encourage straight trunk

name: Holy Basil / Tulsi (Ocimum tenuiflorum)
sunlight: Full Sun to Partial Shade (4-6 hours direct light)
soil: Rich loamy soil, pH 6.0-7.0, excellent moisture retention
waterFrequency: Daily or when top 2cm of soil feels dry
description: Sacred aromatic herb widely cultivated for medicinal teas, essential oils, and home herbal gardens.
plantingAdvice: Sow seeds shallowly in rich loamy soil. Keep soil consistently moist until germination (7-14 days). Pinch flower buds early to prolong leaf growth.
aftercareChecklist: Pinch top growing leaves regularly to encourage bushy lateral growth
Avoid waterlogging soil to prevent fungal root rot
Add organic worm castings or compost monthly during active growth

name: Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum)
soil: Organic-rich loamy soil, pH 6.0-6.8, high potassium balance
waterFrequency: Deep watering every 2-3 days at soil base
description: Versatile home vegetable garden staple yielding juicy, nutrient-rich fruit throughout summer.
plantingAdvice: Bury seedlings deep up to top leaves so main stems root strongly. Stake or cage young plants early to support heavy fruiting branches.
aftercareChecklist: Provide sturdy wooden stakes or metal cages for vertical support
Prune bottom leaves touching the ground to prevent fungal blight
Maintain consistent soil moisture to prevent blossom end rot

name: Moringa / Drumstick Tree (Moringa oleifera)
soil: Sandy or loamy well-drained soil, pH 6.3-7.0
description: Nutrient-dense superfood tree producing edible leaves and long seed pods, fast-growing and drought resilient.
plantingAdvice: Direct seed or transplant seedlings into well-drained soil. Cut main trunk back at 1.5m to produce dense branching for easy leaf harvest.
aftercareChecklist: Prune back branches yearly to maintain manageable harvest height
Ensure soil drainage is excellent; Moringa roots decay quickly in standing water
Harvest leaves frequently to promote continuous new shoot emergence

name: Aloe Vera
sunlight: Bright Indirect Sun or Partial Sunlight
soil: Cactus or coarse sandy mix with high permeability, pH 7.0-8.5
waterFrequency: Once every 10-14 days; allow soil to dry completely
description: Hardy perennial succulent known for skin-soothing gel and low-maintenance indoor air purification.
plantingAdvice: Use terracotta pots with bottom drainage holes. Avoid excessive direct harsh midday sun which can scorch leaves brownish-red.
aftercareChecklist: Allow soil to dry thoroughly between waterings
Separate mature side pups for propagation in spring
Protect from frost and temperatures below 10°C

name: Mango Tree (Mangifera indica)
soil: Deep, well-drained alluvial or loamy soil, pH 5.5-7.5
waterFrequency: Weekly when young; minimal once established
description: Majestic long-lived fruit tree providing dense shade canopy and sweet tropical summer fruits.
plantingAdvice: Dig pit 1m x 1m x 1m. Mix topsoil with decomposed farmyard manure. Plant grafted sapling carefully without breaking root ball.
aftercareChecklist: Protect young saplings from harsh wind with wooden supports
Apply balanced organic fertilizer twice a year (post-monsoon & pre-bloom)
Withhold heavy watering during flowering to encourage fruit set
